I.value_en: Current fcop/fcop-mcp versions, sprint plan, rules/source/templates/tests, release SOP, ADR-0034 and repository state.
I.notes_zh: 外部状态未被断言为已验证。
I.notes_en: External state is not asserted as verified.

O.value_zh: C 阶段代码和协议变更、2.0.0 tag/PyPI/GitHub Release、发布后 redeploy/ADR/REPORT/归档闭环。
O.value_en: C-stage code and protocol changes, 2.0.0 tag/PyPI/GitHub Release, and post-release redeploy/ADR/REPORT/archive closure.

O.notes_en: Outputs depend on stage gates and external verification.

A.value_zh: 实施 C1–C12、dry-run 与本地测试；在 D2 停手；仅在 ADMIN 二次确认后 tag/push/发布；完成 E 阶段后续事项。
A.value_en: Implement C1–C12, dry-run and local tests; stop at D2; tag/push/publish only after second ADMIN confirmation; perform E-stage follow-up.
A.notes_zh: 审定不执行任何发布动作。

P.value_zh: ADMIN 启动 Sprint 并须二次确认；ME 执行受门控的步骤；redeploy 由 ADMIN 在三个仓库执行。
P.value_en: ADMIN starts Sprint and must confirm a second time; ME performs gated steps; ADMIN redeploys in three repositories.
P.notes_zh: 角色不替代 OperatorProfile 或发布权限绑定。
P.notes_en: Roles do not replace OperatorProfile or release authority binding.

R.value_zh: P0、高风险、12 个 C 子变更、4 个 D 阶段、3 个 E 阶段、1061+ 旧测试与 5/5 job；无截止时间。
R.value_en: P0, high risk, 12 C subchanges, four D stages, three E stages, 1061+ old tests and 5/5 jobs; no deadline.
R.notes_zh: 风险等级触发而非消除门控。
R.notes_en: Risk level triggers, not removes, gating.

V.value_zh: Rule 7/8/9.5.1、ADR-0006、release-process v2、Sprint、ADR-0034 与 v1.6.0 sprint 引用。
V.value_en: Rules 7/8/9.5.1, ADR-0006, release-process v2, Sprint, ADR-0034 and v1.6.0 sprint references.

C.value_zh: C1–C12、D1 本地通过、D2 二次确认、D3/D4 tag/PyPI/5 jobs/Release 验证、E1–E3 受限完成。
C.value_en: C1–C12, D1 local pass, D2 second confirmation, D3/D4 tag/PyPI/5 jobs/Release verification, and E1–E3 constrained completion.
C.notes_zh: 条件不是已完成发布事实。
C.notes_en: Conditions are not completed release facts.

B.value_zh: D2 前不得 tag/push/PyPI；不得改 Bridgeflow/codeflow、release SOP、workspace/Rule7.5 或 Sprint 表外事项；不得绕过 Rule 7。
B.value_en: Before D2 do not tag/push/PyPI; do not change Bridgeflow/codeflow, release SOP, workspace/Rule7.5 or items outside Sprint table; do not bypass Rule 7.
B.notes_zh: 一次启动确认明确不等于 D2。
B.notes_en: First startup confirmation explicitly is not D2.
